cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine prepare HANGS Construction's progress billing for November.
First it rebuilds every earlier pay application and ties the history out exactly.
Next it ties each schedule of values, the line-by-line price list, to its contract.
Only change orders the owner has signed are billed.
One unsigned change order is left out.
Stored materials without insurance or approval are held back.
One job's retainage drops to the approved five percent.
Then it drafts the invoices and lien waivers.
Then it ties the billing to the WIP schedule and the ledger.
It also caught a lien waiver that would give up an unpaid invoice.
Two applications are ready, about $190,500 due, for the controller to sign.
All done. Two pay applications, with their invoices and waivers, are drafted, with four items to settle first. Nothing was posted, signed or sent; the controller reviews and signs.
Jumping to the results. A person still reviews every item before anything is posted, paid or sent.
